statement: A Saturn Dasha (at any timescale — Mahadasha, Antardasha, or finer) generally brings a period of discipline, delay, and hard-won achievement — favors are earned slowly through sustained effort rather than given easily, a genuine test of endurance rather than a purely difficult period.
editorial_note: BPHS distinguishes general effects (a planet's natural characteristics) from distinctive effects (its specific dignity/placement in a given chart) — only the general tier is claimed here; this pass's Dasha computation doesn't evaluate planetary dignity or strength.
